entries.definition: to become less intense or make something smaller

examples.en: We waited indoors for the storm to abate.
examples.zh: 我们待在屋内等待暴风雨减弱。

examples.en: The new measures helped abate traffic noise.
examples.zh: 新措施有助于减轻交通噪声。

entries.definition: the skill or power needed to do something

examples.en: The course improved her ability to explain complex ideas.
examples.zh: 这门课程提高了她解释复杂概念的能力。

examples.en: Swimming is an ability that takes practice.
examples.zh: 游泳是一项需要练习的本领。

entries.definition: to exist in large numbers or amounts

examples.en: Wild flowers abound in the valley during spring.
examples.zh: 春天山谷里开满了野花。

examples.en: The report abounds with practical suggestions.
examples.zh: 这份报告中有许多实用建议。

entries.definition: complete and not limited in any way

examples.en: The laboratory requires absolute silence during the recording.
examples.zh: 录音时实验室要求绝对安静。

examples.en: There is no absolute guarantee that the plan will work.
examples.zh: 无法绝对保证这个计划会成功。

entries.definition: an idea separated from particular physical examples

examples.en: Freedom can seem like an abstraction until it is lost.
examples.zh: 自由在失去之前可能像一个抽象概念。

examples.en: The diagram uses abstraction to hide unnecessary details.
examples.zh: 这幅图通过抽象处理隐藏不必要的细节。

entries.definition: the harmful or improper use of something

examples.en: The investigation revealed an abuse of public funds.
examples.zh: 调查揭露了公共资金遭到滥用。

examples.en: The rules aim to prevent the abuse of power.
examples.zh: 这些规则旨在防止权力滥用。

entries.definition: cruel treatment or insulting language

examples.en: The charity supports children who have suffered abuse.
examples.zh: 这家慈善机构帮助遭受虐待的儿童。

examples.en: The referee received verbal abuse from the crowd.
examples.zh: 裁判遭到了人群的辱骂。

entries.definition: to use something improperly or harmfully

examples.en: Some employers abuse their authority over workers.
examples.zh: 一些雇主滥用对工人的管理权。

examples.en: Do not abuse the trust your colleagues place in you.
examples.zh: 不要滥用同事对你的信任。

entries.definition: to treat someone cruelly or speak to them insultingly

examples.en: The law protects animals from people who abuse them.
examples.zh: 法律保护动物免受虐待。

examples.en: Passengers must not abuse the station staff.
examples.zh: 乘客不得辱骂车站工作人员。

entries.definition: good enough to be allowed or approved

examples.en: The committee found an acceptable solution to the dispute.
examples.zh: 委员会找到了一个各方可以接受的争议解决方案。

examples.en: A short delay is acceptable if the work is accurate.
examples.zh: 只要工作准确，短暂延误是可以接受的。

entries.definition: an extra item used with a larger object

examples.en: A waterproof case is a useful camera accessory.
examples.zh: 防水套是一种实用的相机配件。

examples.en: The shop sells every accessory needed for the bicycle.
examples.zh: 这家商店出售这辆自行车所需的各种配件。

entries.definition: an item worn to complement clothing

examples.en: She chose a silver belt as her only accessory.
examples.zh: 她只选了一条银色腰带作服饰配件。

examples.en: A scarf can be a practical winter accessory.
examples.zh: 围巾可以是实用的冬季服饰配件。

entries.definition: a person who helps another person commit a crime

examples.en: The driver was charged as an accessory to the robbery.
examples.zh: 司机被指控为这起抢劫案的从犯。

examples.en: Hiding the stolen goods made him an accessory.
examples.zh: 他因藏匿赃物而成为帮凶。

entries.definition: a place where someone can stay or live

examples.en: The college provides accommodation for overseas students.
examples.zh: 学院为海外学生提供住宿。

examples.en: We need affordable accommodation near the station.
examples.zh: 我们需要车站附近价格合理的住处。

examples.en: The price includes accommodation but not meals.
examples.zh: 价格包含住宿，但不含餐食。

entries.definition: An adjustment made to fit new conditions or needs.

examples.en: The school made an accommodation for her visual needs.
examples.zh: 学校根据她的视觉需求作了调整。

examples.en: Successful accommodation to a new climate takes time.
examples.zh: 成功适应新气候需要时间。

entries.definition: The adjustment of the eye's focus for different distances.

examples.en: The diagram explains accommodation when looking at a nearby object.
examples.zh: 图解说明看近处物体时眼的调节作用。

examples.en: The researcher measured changes in visual accommodation.
examples.zh: 研究人员测量了视觉调节的变化。

entries.definition: a financial record or arrangement for holding money

examples.en: I opened a savings account at the local bank.
examples.zh: 我在当地银行开了一个储蓄账户。

examples.en: The accountant checked every entry in the account.
examples.zh: 会计检查了账目中的每笔记录。

entries.definition: a spoken or written description of events

examples.en: The witness gave a clear account of the accident.
examples.zh: 证人清楚地叙述了事故经过。

examples.en: Her account of the journey included several useful maps.
examples.zh: 她的旅行记述附有几幅实用地图。

entries.meaning: 解释；说明原因；导致（account for）
entries.definition: to explain something or be the reason for it

examples.en: How do you account for the missing equipment?
examples.zh: 你如何解释设备丢失这件事？

examples.en: Heavy rain may account for the fall in visitor numbers.
examples.zh: 大雨可能是游客人数下降的原因。

entries.definition: to form a particular share of a total

examples.en: Rent and bills account for half of my monthly spending.
examples.zh: 房租和账单占我每月开支的一半。

examples.en: Online orders account for most of the company's sales.
examples.zh: 网上订单占该公司销售额的大部分。

entries.definition: to officially recognize someone as qualified or authorized

examples.en: The board will accredit the training programme next year.
examples.zh: 委员会将于明年正式认证这项培训计划。

examples.en: The government can accredit new diplomatic representatives.
examples.zh: 政府可以正式委任新的外交代表。

entries.meaning: 把……归功于；认为……具有（accredit to/with）
entries.definition: to attribute an achievement or quality to someone

examples.en: Historians accredit the discovery to a local engineer.
examples.zh: 历史学家把这项发现归功于一位当地工程师。

examples.en: Several colleagues accredit her with saving the project.
examples.zh: 几位同事认为是她挽救了这个项目。

entries.definition: the degree to which something is correct or exact

examples.en: We checked the accuracy of the survey results.
examples.zh: 我们检查了调查结果的准确性。

examples.en: The new instrument measures distance with greater accuracy.
examples.zh: 新仪器测量距离更加精确。

entries.definition: something successfully accomplished through effort

examples.en: Completing the marathon was her greatest achievement.
examples.zh: 跑完马拉松是她最大的成就。

examples.en: The award recognizes outstanding achievement in science.
examples.zh: 这个奖项表彰科学领域的杰出成就。

entries.definition: the successful reaching of a goal or standard

examples.en: Regular feedback supports the achievement of learning goals.
examples.zh: 定期反馈有助于实现学习目标。

examples.en: The achievement of equal access remains a challenge.
examples.zh: 实现平等的使用机会仍是一项挑战。

entries.definition: producing sound without electronic amplification

examples.en: He played an acoustic guitar at the small concert.
examples.zh: 他在小型音乐会上弹奏了一把原声吉他。

examples.en: The singer released an acoustic version of the song.
examples.zh: 这位歌手发行了这首歌的原声版本。

entries.definition: relating to sound or the way it is heard

examples.en: The engineers tested the room's acoustic properties.
examples.zh: 工程师测试了房间的声学特性。

examples.en: The device uses an acoustic signal to measure depth.
examples.zh: 这台设备利用声信号测量深度。

entries.definition: to gain or obtain something over time

examples.en: Students acquire practical skills during the placement.
examples.zh: 学生在实习期间获得实践技能。

examples.en: The museum hopes to acquire the artist's early drawings.
examples.zh: 博物馆希望购得这位艺术家的早期素描。

entries.meaning: 杂技的；动作灵活高难的
entries.definition: involving skilful balancing or gymnastic movements

examples.en: The audience applauded the acrobatic performance.
examples.zh: 观众为杂技表演鼓掌。

examples.en: The goalkeeper made an acrobatic leap to reach the ball.
examples.zh: 守门员以一个高难度跃起动作够到了球。

entries.definition: the ability to make quick and effective judgements

examples.en: Her business acumen helped the small company survive.
examples.zh: 她精明的商业判断帮助这家小公司生存下来。

examples.en: The role requires political acumen as well as patience.
examples.zh: 这项工作既需要政治判断力，也需要耐心。

entries.definition: to change in order to suit new conditions

examples.en: New students often need time to adapt to university life.
examples.zh: 新生通常需要时间适应大学生活。

examples.en: We must adapt the timetable to the new transport schedule.
examples.zh: 我们必须调整时间表以适应新的交通班次。

entries.definition: to change a work into another form

examples.en: The director plans to adapt the novel for television.
examples.zh: 导演打算把这部小说改编成电视剧。

examples.en: They adapted the play for a younger audience.
examples.zh: 他们为更年轻的观众改编了这部戏剧。

entries.definition: a strong dependence on a substance or activity

examples.en: The clinic offers support for people with alcohol addiction.
examples.zh: 这家诊所为酒精成瘾者提供帮助。

examples.en: His addiction to online games began to affect his sleep.
examples.zh: 他沉迷网络游戏，开始影响睡眠。

entries.definition: to deal with a problem or issue

examples.en: The council must address the shortage of housing.
examples.zh: 地方议会必须处理住房短缺问题。

examples.en: This proposal does not address the main concern.
examples.zh: 这个提议没有回应主要担忧。

examples.en: Schools need to address the causes of poor attendance.
examples.zh: 学校需要处理出勤率低的原因。

entries.definition: information showing where a person or place can be found

examples.en: Please write your home address on the form.
examples.zh: 请在表格上填写家庭地址。

examples.en: The parcel was sent to the wrong address.
examples.zh: 包裹被寄到了错误的地址。

examples.en: Have you updated your postal address?
examples.zh: 你更新邮寄地址了吗？

entries.definition: To write a destination on mail or direct a message to someone.

examples.en: Address the envelope to the admissions office.
examples.zh: 在信封上写明寄给招生办公室。

examples.en: She addressed her complaint to the manager.
examples.zh: 她把投诉信写给了经理。

entries.definition: To speak formally to a person or group.

examples.en: The mayor addressed the assembled crowd.
examples.zh: 市长向聚集的人群发表讲话。

examples.en: She addressed the conference on its opening day.
examples.zh: 她在会议开幕当天致辞。

entries.definition: A formal speech delivered to an audience.

examples.en: His opening address lasted ten minutes.
examples.zh: 他的开幕致辞持续了十分钟。

examples.en: The graduation address encouraged students to remain curious.
examples.zh: 毕业致辞鼓励学生保持好奇心。

entries.definition: next to or very close to something

examples.en: The laboratory is adjacent to the main library.
examples.zh: 实验室紧挨着主图书馆。

examples.en: We booked two adjacent rooms for the family.
examples.zh: 我们为一家人订了两个相邻的房间。

entries.definition: to manage an organization or system

examples.en: A small team will administer the scholarship programme.
examples.zh: 一个小团队将管理这项奖学金计划。

examples.en: The council administers several public housing schemes.
examples.zh: 市政委员会管理着几项公共住房计划。

entries.definition: to give a medicine or treatment

examples.en: Only trained staff may administer this medicine.
examples.zh: 只有受过培训的工作人员才能给予这种药物。

examples.en: The nurse prepared to administer the prescribed injection.
examples.zh: 护士准备注射医嘱规定的药物。

entries.definition: a person who manages an organization or its work

examples.en: The school administrator handles student records.
examples.zh: 学校行政人员负责学生档案。

examples.en: Ask the system administrator to reset your account.
examples.zh: 请系统管理员重置你的账户。

entries.definition: a building material made from earth dried in the sun

examples.en: The village houses were built from adobe.
examples.zh: 村里的房屋是用土坯建成的。

examples.en: Workers repaired the damaged adobe wall before winter.
examples.zh: 工人们在入冬前修好了受损的泥砖墙。

entries.definition: to begin using a method or idea

examples.en: Schools may adopt new teaching methods.
examples.zh: 学校可能采用新的教学方法。

examples.en: Businesses need time to adopt new technology.
examples.zh: 企业需要时间来采用新技术。

examples.en: The council agreed to adopt the proposed policy.
examples.zh: 地方议会同意采用这项拟议政策。

entries.definition: To legally take a child into one's family or take an animal into one's care.

examples.en: The couple adopted a young child.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇收养了一个幼儿。

examples.en: They adopted a dog from the local shelter.
examples.zh: 他们从当地收容所领养了一只狗。

entries.definition: To formally accept a proposal or resolution.

examples.en: The committee adopted the resolution unanimously.
examples.zh: 委员会一致通过了决议。

examples.en: The assembly adopted a revised constitution.
examples.zh: 大会通过了修订后的章程。

entries.definition: a useful or favourable feature

examples.en: One advantage of remote work is less commuting.
examples.zh: 远程工作的一个好处是减少通勤。

examples.en: Small classes offer an advantage for individual feedback.
examples.zh: 小班教学在提供个别反馈方面有优势。

examples.en: The main advantage of this option is its lower cost.
examples.zh: 这个选项的主要优势是成本较低。

entries.definition: an unusual and exciting experience

examples.en: Exploring the island became an unforgettable adventure.
examples.zh: 探索这座岛成了一次难忘的冒险。

examples.en: The children listened eagerly to her travel adventures.
examples.zh: 孩子们热切地听她讲旅行中的奇遇。

entries.definition: to make something publicly known in order to attract interest

examples.en: The shop will advertise its opening in the local paper.
examples.zh: 这家商店将在当地报纸上刊登开业广告。

examples.en: The university advertises research positions on its website.
examples.zh: 这所大学在网站上公布科研岗位。

entries.definition: sensible and worth doing in the circumstances

examples.en: It is advisable to book a seat in advance.
examples.zh: 提前订座是明智的。

examples.en: Taking a paper map is advisable in this remote area.
examples.zh: 在这片偏远地区携带纸质地图是适当的。

entries.definition: energetic exercises often performed to music

examples.en: She attends an aerobics class twice a week.
examples.zh: 她每周上两次有氧健身操课。

examples.en: The sports centre offers low-impact aerobics for beginners.
examples.zh: 体育中心为初学者提供低冲击有氧健身操。

entries.meaning: 航空航天领域；大气层与外层空间
entries.definition: the field of aircraft and spacecraft technology

examples.en: Many aerospace companies recruit mechanical engineers.
examples.zh: 许多航空航天企业招聘机械工程师。

examples.en: The university opened a new aerospace research centre.
examples.zh: 这所大学开设了新的航空航天研究中心。

entries.definition: to cause serious trouble or suffering

examples.en: Drought continues to afflict farming communities.
examples.zh: 干旱持续困扰着农业社区。

examples.en: The illness can afflict people of any age.
examples.zh: 这种疾病可能折磨任何年龄的人。

entries.definition: to have enough money or time for something

examples.en: We cannot afford a larger apartment this year.
examples.zh: 我们今年买不起更大的公寓。

examples.en: Can you afford to take a whole week off?
examples.zh: 你能抽出整整一周时间休假吗？

entries.definition: an organization that provides a service

examples.en: A recruitment agency helped him find temporary work.
examples.zh: 一家招聘机构帮他找到了临时工作。

examples.en: The environmental agency published its annual report.
examples.zh: 环保机构发布了年度报告。

entries.meaning: 代理；作用；自主行动能力
entries.definition: the action or capacity of acting on someone's behalf or independently

examples.en: The agreement defines the terms of agency between the firms.
examples.zh: 协议规定了两家公司之间的代理条款。

examples.en: Giving pupils more choices can strengthen their sense of agency.
examples.zh: 给学生更多选择能够增强他们的自主感。

entries.definition: the act of making a problem more serious

examples.en: The report links the delay to an aggravation of the crisis.
examples.zh: 报告指出延误使危机加剧。

examples.en: Repeated strain may cause an aggravation of the old injury.
examples.zh: 反复受力可能使旧伤加重。

entries.definition: annoyance or something that causes it

examples.en: The broken printer caused endless aggravation.
examples.zh: 坏掉的打印机让人烦恼不已。

examples.en: She wanted to avoid the aggravation of another dispute.
examples.zh: 她想避免再次争吵带来的烦恼。

entries.definition: able to move or think quickly and easily

examples.en: The agile cat climbed onto the narrow fence.
examples.zh: 那只敏捷的猫爬上了狭窄的围栏。

examples.en: An agile team can respond quickly to new evidence.
examples.zh: 灵活的团队能够迅速回应新证据。

entries.definition: sealed so that air cannot pass through

examples.en: Keep the biscuits in an airtight container.
examples.zh: 把饼干放在密封容器里。

examples.en: The technician checked whether the chamber was airtight.
examples.zh: 技术员检查了这个舱室是否气密。

entries.definition: so well designed that it cannot easily be challenged

examples.en: The lawyer presented an airtight argument.
examples.zh: 律师提出了无懈可击的论证。

examples.en: We need an airtight plan for protecting the data.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个严密可靠的数据保护计划。

entries.definition: although or even though

examples.en: The service is useful, albeit expensive.
examples.zh: 这项服务很有用，尽管价格昂贵。

examples.en: The team made progress, albeit more slowly than expected.
examples.zh: 团队取得了进展，尽管比预期慢。

entries.definition: quick to notice danger or changes

examples.en: Drivers must remain alert on this narrow road.
examples.zh: 驾驶员在这条狭窄道路上必须保持警觉。

examples.en: She was alert to the risks of sharing personal data.
examples.zh: 她对分享个人数据的风险保持警惕。

entries.definition: a warning or a state of readiness for danger

examples.en: The weather alert warned of heavy snowfall.
examples.zh: 天气警报提醒人们注意大雪。

examples.en: The hospital remained on alert throughout the night.
examples.zh: 医院整夜保持警戒状态。

entries.definition: to warn someone about a danger or problem

examples.en: The sensor will alert staff if the door opens.
examples.zh: 如果门被打开，传感器会向工作人员报警。

examples.en: Residents alerted the council to the damaged bridge.
examples.zh: 居民提醒市政委员会注意桥梁损坏的问题。

entries.definition: to make someone feel excluded or hostile

examples.en: Ignoring complaints may alienate loyal customers.
examples.zh: 无视投诉可能使忠实顾客疏远。

examples.en: The policy risks alienating younger voters.
examples.zh: 这项政策可能使年轻选民产生反感。

entries.definition: to transfer ownership or a legal right

examples.en: The trust cannot alienate the land without approval.
examples.zh: 未经批准，信托机构不得转让这片土地。

examples.en: The agreement limits their power to alienate property.
examples.zh: 协议限制了他们转让财产的权力。

entries.definition: the arrangement of things in a straight line or correct position

examples.en: The mechanic checked the alignment of the wheels.
examples.zh: 技工检查了车轮的定位。

examples.en: The image shows the alignment of the planets.
examples.zh: 这幅图展示了行星排列的位置。

entries.definition: agreement or cooperation between people or groups

examples.en: The strategy brings spending into alignment with our goals.
examples.zh: 这项策略使支出与我们的目标保持一致。

examples.en: A new political alignment emerged after the election.
examples.zh: 选举后出现了新的政治联盟格局。

entries.definition: a harmful physical reaction to a normally harmless substance

examples.en: Please tell the restaurant about your nut allergy.
examples.zh: 请告诉餐厅你对坚果过敏。

examples.en: She has an allergy to certain medicines.
examples.zh: 她对某些药物过敏。

examples.en: An allergy can cause a skin rash.
examples.zh: 过敏可能引起皮疹。

entries.definition: to give a share of something for a purpose

examples.en: The city should allocate more money to public transport.
examples.zh: 这座城市应该为公共交通分配更多资金。

examples.en: Managers allocate tasks according to staff experience.
examples.zh: 经理根据员工经验分配任务。

examples.en: We need to allocate enough time for revision.
examples.zh: 我们需要为复习分配足够时间。

entries.definition: a quality that attracts or tempts people

examples.en: The island's quiet beaches have a special allure.
examples.zh: 岛上宁静的海滩有一种特殊的吸引力。

examples.en: The allure of fame drew him towards acting.
examples.zh: 名气的诱惑使他走向演艺行业。

entries.definition: to attract someone strongly

examples.en: The promise of discovery continues to allure young explorers.
examples.zh: 发现新事物的前景持续吸引着年轻探险者。

examples.en: Bright displays allure visitors into the market.
examples.zh: 明亮的陈列吸引游客走进市场。

entries.definition: to make something different or become different

examples.en: We need to alter the design before construction begins.
examples.zh: 开工前我们需要修改设计。

examples.en: The new evidence may alter our understanding of the event.
examples.zh: 新证据可能改变我们对这件事的理解。

entries.definition: height above sea level or another reference point

examples.en: The village stands at an altitude of two thousand metres.
examples.zh: 这个村庄位于海拔两千米处。

examples.en: The pilot reduced altitude before approaching the runway.
examples.zh: 飞行员在接近跑道前降低了高度。

entries.definition: to gather a large amount of something

examples.en: The museum has amassed a valuable collection of maps.
examples.zh: 这座博物馆积累了一批珍贵地图。

examples.en: Over the years, she amassed enough savings to buy a home.
examples.zh: 多年来，她攒够了买房的钱。

entries.definition: an official representative of a country or organization

examples.en: The ambassador met local business leaders.
examples.zh: 大使会见了当地商界领袖。

examples.en: She became an ambassador for the children's charity.
examples.zh: 她成为了这家儿童慈善机构的宣传大使。

entries.definition: a strong wish to achieve something

examples.en: His ambition is to design affordable housing.
examples.zh: 他的志向是设计价格可负担的住房。

examples.en: Her ambition drove her to apply for the demanding course.
examples.zh: 她的抱负促使她申请那门要求严格的课程。

entries.meaning: 无固定形状的；无明确组织的
entries.definition: having no definite shape or clear structure

examples.en: The material cooled into an amorphous solid.
examples.zh: 这种材料冷却后成为无定形固体。

examples.en: The discussion began with an amorphous collection of ideas.
examples.zh: 讨论从一堆尚未成形的想法开始。

entries.definition: to make a sound or effect stronger

examples.en: The microphone amplifies even a quiet voice.
examples.zh: 这个麦克风连轻声说话都能放大。

examples.en: Social media can amplify the effects of a rumour.
examples.zh: 社交媒体会放大谣言的影响。

entries.definition: to add details to an explanation

examples.en: Could you amplify your final point with an example?
examples.zh: 你能举例进一步说明最后一点吗？

examples.en: The speaker amplified the argument in a later article.
examples.zh: 演讲者在后来的文章中详细阐述了这个论点。

entries.definition: to examine something carefully by considering its parts

examples.en: The researchers will analyse the samples tomorrow.
examples.zh: 研究人员明天将分析这些样本。

examples.en: We analysed the interviews to identify common concerns.
examples.zh: 我们分析了访谈，以找出共同的关切。

entries.definition: relating to ancestors or inherited from them

examples.en: The family returned to their ancestral village.
examples.zh: 这家人回到了祖籍村。

examples.en: She inherited an ancestral house near the coast.
examples.zh: 她继承了海岸附近的一栋祖屋。

entries.definition: and other similar things

examples.en: The fee covers books, stationery, and so forth.
examples.zh: 这笔费用包括书籍、文具等等。

examples.en: We discussed transport, housing, employment, and so forth.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了交通、住房、就业等问题。

entries.definition: the space between two meeting lines or surfaces

examples.en: The triangle has one right angle.
examples.zh: 这个三角形有一个直角。

examples.en: Hold the camera at a lower angle.
examples.zh: 把相机拿低一点，换一个较低的角度。

entries.definition: a particular way of considering something

examples.en: Try looking at the problem from another angle.
examples.zh: 试着从另一个角度看这个问题。

examples.en: The article explores the story from a financial angle.
examples.zh: 这篇文章从财务角度探讨了这件事。

entries.meaning: 使倾斜；从特定角度呈现
entries.definition: to position something at a slope or present it from a viewpoint

examples.en: Angle the lamp towards the page.
examples.zh: 把灯斜着朝向书页。

examples.en: The editor angled the report towards younger readers.
examples.zh: 编辑从年轻读者关心的角度组织了这篇报道。

entries.definition: to make someone feel irritated

examples.en: The constant tapping began to annoy everyone.
examples.zh: 不断的敲击声开始让每个人都心烦。

examples.en: It annoys me when people interrupt the speaker.
examples.zh: 别人打断发言者时，我会感到恼火。

entries.definition: a medicine that treats certain bacterial infections

examples.en: The doctor prescribed an antibiotic for the infection.
examples.zh: 医生为这次感染开了抗生素。

examples.en: Scientists are studying resistance to this antibiotic.
examples.zh: 科学家正在研究对这种抗生素的耐药性。

entries.definition: relating to medicines that act against bacteria

examples.en: The laboratory tested the compound's antibiotic properties.
examples.zh: 实验室检测了这种化合物的抗菌性质。

examples.en: The study examined patterns of antibiotic use.
examples.zh: 这项研究考察了抗生素的使用模式。

entries.definition: a substance that counteracts a poison

examples.en: The medical team identified the appropriate antidote.
examples.zh: 医疗团队确定了合适的解毒剂。

examples.en: The laboratory stores an antidote for the toxin.
examples.zh: 实验室备有针对这种毒素的解毒剂。

entries.meaning: 补救办法；消除不良影响的方法
entries.definition: something that counteracts a harmful feeling or situation

examples.en: A walk outside can be an antidote to a stressful day.
examples.zh: 出去散步可以缓解一天的压力。

examples.en: Good evidence is an antidote to unfounded rumours.
examples.zh: 可靠证据是驳斥无根据谣言的良方。

entries.definition: the distant past or the state of being very old

examples.en: The trade route was important in antiquity.
examples.zh: 这条贸易路线在古代十分重要。

examples.en: The antiquity of the manuscript surprised the researchers.
examples.zh: 这份手稿年代之久让研究人员惊讶。

entries.meaning: 古物；古迹（常用复数 antiquities）
entries.definition: an object or building surviving from ancient times

examples.en: The gallery displays antiquities from the Mediterranean.
examples.zh: 这家美术馆陈列着地中海地区的古物。

examples.en: Exporting these antiquities requires official permission.
examples.zh: 出口这些古物需要官方许可。

entries.definition: at a fast and continuing rate

examples.en: Construction continued apace despite the cold weather.
examples.zh: 尽管天气寒冷，施工仍迅速推进。

examples.en: Technology in this field is developing apace.
examples.zh: 这个领域的技术正在快速发展。

entries.definition: to say that you are sorry

examples.en: I apologise for the delay in replying.
examples.zh: 我为回复延迟而道歉。

examples.en: We apologise for any inconvenience caused.
examples.zh: 我们对造成的不便表示歉意。

examples.en: You should apologise to your colleague for the mistake.
examples.zh: 你应该为这个错误向同事道歉。

entries.definition: according to appearances or available information

examples.en: Apparently, the last train leaves at eleven.
examples.zh: 看来，末班火车十一点出发。

examples.en: The apparently simple task required careful planning.
examples.zh: 这项看似简单的任务需要仔细规划。

entries.definition: the way someone or something looks

examples.en: The renovation improved the building's appearance.
examples.zh: 翻修改善了建筑的外观。

examples.en: Do not judge the quality of fruit by appearance alone.
examples.zh: 不要只凭外观判断水果的品质。

entries.definition: the act of becoming visible or attending an event

examples.en: The sudden appearance of clouds changed our plans.
examples.zh: 云层突然出现，改变了我们的计划。

examples.en: The author made a brief appearance at the bookshop.
examples.zh: 作者在书店短暂露面。

entries.definition: a device used for a particular household task

examples.en: Choose an appliance that uses less electricity.
examples.zh: 选择耗电更少的家用电器。

examples.en: The kitchen has space for another small appliance.
examples.zh: 厨房还有地方放一件小型电器。

entries.definition: to formally ask for a job, place, or permission

examples.en: She plans to apply for a research grant.
examples.zh: 她计划申请一笔研究资助。

examples.en: You must apply before the end of March.
examples.zh: 你必须在三月底前提出申请。

entries.definition: to put something into use or onto a surface

examples.en: We can apply this method to other cities.
examples.zh: 我们可以把这种方法应用于其他城市。

examples.en: Apply a thin layer of paint to the wood.
examples.zh: 在木头上涂一层薄薄的油漆。

entries.definition: to be relevant to a person or situation

examples.en: The discount does not apply to weekend bookings.
examples.zh: 这个折扣不适用于周末预订。

examples.en: These rules apply equally to every member.
examples.zh: 这些规则同样适用于每位成员。

entries.definition: to divide something among people according to a plan

examples.en: The committee will apportion funds among the projects.
examples.zh: 委员会将把资金分配给各个项目。

examples.en: They agreed to apportion the costs equally.
examples.zh: 他们同意平均分摊费用。

entries.definition: a way of dealing with something

examples.en: A flexible approach may produce better results.
examples.zh: 灵活的方法可能产生更好的结果。

examples.en: This approach focuses on prevention rather than treatment.
examples.zh: 这种方法侧重预防而不是治疗。

examples.en: The school adopted a new approach to reading instruction.
examples.zh: 学校采用了新的阅读教学方法。

entries.meaning: 接近；靠近；临近；即将到来
entries.definition: To move closer in distance or time.

examples.en: Please slow down as you approach the junction.
examples.zh: 接近路口时请减速。

examples.en: Visitors must not approach the wild animals.
examples.zh: 游客不得靠近野生动物。

examples.en: We could see the coast as we began to approach the island.
examples.zh: 开始靠近小岛时，我们能看见海岸。

examples.en: As winter approaches, the nights become longer.
examples.zh: 随着冬天临近，夜晚变长。

examples.en: The deadline is approaching faster than we expected.
examples.zh: 截止日期比我们预想的更快地临近了。

entries.definition: The act of getting nearer or the arrival of a time.

examples.en: The birds scattered at our approach.
examples.zh: 我们靠近时，鸟儿四散飞走。

examples.en: The approach of winter prompted urgent repairs.
examples.zh: 冬季临近，促使人们赶紧维修。

entries.definition: to think that something is good or acceptable

examples.en: Her parents approve of her decision to study abroad.
examples.zh: 她的父母赞成她出国学习的决定。

examples.en: Not everyone approved of the proposed changes.
examples.zh: 并不是所有人都赞成拟议的调整。

entries.definition: to officially accept or permit something

examples.en: The council must approve the building plans.
examples.zh: 市政委员会必须批准建筑方案。

examples.en: The manager approved my request for leave.
examples.zh: 经理批准了我的休假申请。

entries.definition: especially suitable for a situation

examples.en: That is an apt description of the problem.
examples.zh: 那是对这个问题的恰当描述。

examples.en: She chose an apt quotation to open the speech.
examples.zh: 她选了一句贴切的引语作为演讲开头。

entries.definition: likely to behave or happen in a particular way

examples.en: This old engine is apt to overheat.
examples.zh: 这台旧发动机容易过热。

examples.en: People are apt to forget details after a long delay.
examples.zh: 时间久了，人们容易忘记细节。

entries.definition: quick to learn and understand

examples.en: He proved an apt pupil in the workshop.
examples.zh: 事实证明，他在实训课上是个悟性很好的学生。

examples.en: The apt young musician mastered the passage quickly.
examples.zh: 这位聪慧的年轻乐手很快掌握了这个乐段。

entries.definition: suitable for growing crops

examples.en: Only a small part of the island is arable land.
examples.zh: 岛上只有一小部分是可耕地。

examples.en: The project aims to protect arable soil from erosion.
examples.zh: 这个项目旨在保护可耕土壤免受侵蚀。

entries.definition: land used or suitable for growing crops

examples.en: The estate includes woodland and arable.
examples.zh: 这处庄园包括林地和耕地。

examples.en: Some pasture was converted to arable.
examples.zh: 一些牧场被改成了耕地。

entries.definition: a person who designs buildings

examples.en: The architect included a courtyard in the design.
examples.zh: 建筑师在设计中加入了一个庭院。

examples.en: We hired an architect to restore the old house.
examples.zh: 我们聘请了一位建筑师修复这栋老房子。

entries.definition: a person responsible for creating a plan or system

examples.en: She was the architect of the new training scheme.
examples.zh: 她是这项新培训计划的设计者。

examples.en: The programme's chief architect defended its aims.
examples.zh: 该计划的主要策划者为其目标作了辩护。

entries.definition: to disagree with someone in words

examples.en: The neighbours argued about the boundary wall.
examples.zh: 邻居们为界墙问题争论。

examples.en: They argued for hours without reaching a decision.
examples.zh: 他们争论了几个小时，仍未作出决定。

entries.definition: to give reasons supporting a position

examples.en: The report argues that public transport needs more funding.
examples.zh: 报告主张公共交通需要更多资金。

examples.en: She argued him into accepting the compromise.
examples.zh: 她通过说理劝他接受了折中方案。

entries.definition: the use of numbers in calculations

examples.en: The children practised mental arithmetic every morning.
examples.zh: 孩子们每天早上练习心算。

examples.en: A simple arithmetic error changed the final total.
examples.zh: 一个简单的算术错误改变了最终总数。

entries.definition: a plan or action made to organize something

examples.en: We confirmed the travel arrangements by email.
examples.zh: 我们通过电子邮件确认了旅行安排。

examples.en: The arrangement allows both teams to share the room.
examples.zh: 这项安排让两个团队能够共用房间。

entries.definition: the way objects are positioned

examples.en: The seating arrangement encourages group discussion.
examples.zh: 座位的排列有利于小组讨论。

examples.en: She changed the arrangement of the flowers.
examples.zh: 她改变了花朵的摆放方式。

entries.definition: an attitude of believing oneself superior to others

examples.en: His arrogance made it difficult to work with him.
examples.zh: 他的傲慢使别人很难与他共事。

examples.en: Confidence should not turn into arrogance.
examples.zh: 自信不应变成自大。

entries.definition: a condition involving painful inflammation of joints

examples.en: Arthritis made it difficult for her to open the jar.
examples.zh: 关节炎使她难以打开罐子。

examples.en: The clinic studies how arthritis affects daily movement.
examples.zh: 这家诊所研究关节炎如何影响日常活动。

entries.definition: in a way that suggests something is true

examples.en: He looked as if he had not slept.
examples.zh: 他看起来好像没睡过觉。

examples.en: She smiled as though she already knew the answer.
examples.zh: 她微笑着，仿佛早已知道答案。

entries.definition: to consider something caused or created by someone or something

examples.en: Researchers ascribe the decline to habitat loss.
examples.zh: 研究人员把这种下降归因于栖息地丧失。

examples.en: The painting was once ascribed to a famous local artist.
examples.zh: 这幅画曾被认为出自一位著名当地画家。

entries.definition: a strong hope of achieving something

examples.en: Her aspiration is to become a civil engineer.
examples.zh: 她的志向是成为一名土木工程师。

examples.en: The programme supports the career aspirations of young people.
examples.zh: 这个项目支持年轻人的职业抱负。

entries.definition: to come together or bring people together

examples.en: The volunteers assembled outside the town hall.
examples.zh: 志愿者们在市政厅外集合。

examples.en: We assembled a team of engineers and designers.
examples.zh: 我们组建了一支由工程师和设计师组成的团队。

entries.definition: to fit parts together into a complete object

examples.en: It took an hour to assemble the bookshelf.
examples.zh: 组装这个书架花了一个小时。

examples.en: Workers assemble the bicycles in a nearby factory.
examples.zh: 工人们在附近的一家工厂组装自行车。

entries.definition: the process of judging knowledge or performance

examples.en: The course includes continuous assessment.
examples.zh: 这门课程包括持续性考核。

examples.en: The assessment measures practical skills.
examples.zh: 这项考核衡量实践技能。

examples.en: Students receive feedback after each assessment.
examples.zh: 学生每次考核后都会收到反馈。

entries.definition: An officially calculated amount that must be paid.

examples.en: The owner disputed the tax assessment.
examples.zh: 业主对核定税额提出了异议。

examples.en: Each household received an assessment for the repair costs.
examples.zh: 每户收到了核定的维修费用金额。

entries.meaning: 作业；学习任务；工作任务
entries.definition: A piece of work that someone is given to complete.

examples.en: The assignment must be submitted online.
examples.zh: 作业必须在线提交。

examples.en: Our final assignment is a short research report.
examples.zh: 我们的期末作业是一篇简短的研究报告。

examples.en: Ask your tutor if the assignment instructions are unclear.
examples.zh: 如果作业要求不清楚，请询问导师。

examples.en: Her first assignment was to interview the factory manager.
examples.zh: 她的第一项工作任务是采访工厂经理。

examples.en: The journalist completed a difficult overseas assignment.
examples.zh: 这名记者完成了一项艰难的海外任务。

entries.definition: to help someone do something

examples.en: A volunteer assisted the visitors with their luggage.
examples.zh: 一名志愿者帮助游客搬运行李。

examples.en: The software assists researchers in organizing references.
examples.zh: 这款软件帮助研究人员整理参考文献。

entries.meaning: 助教或助研职位；相应助学资助
entries.definition: a university position that supports a graduate student through teaching or research work

examples.en: Her assistantship covers part of her tuition fees.
examples.zh: 她的助教资助承担了部分学费。

examples.en: He accepted a research assistantship in the physics department.
examples.zh: 他接受了物理系的一份研究助理职位。

entries.definition: to accept something as true without proof

examples.en: Do not assume that every household owns a car.
examples.zh: 不要假定每个家庭都有汽车。

examples.en: We assumed the library would remain open late.
examples.zh: 我们以为图书馆会开放到很晚。

entries.definition: to take on a responsibility or role

examples.en: She will assume responsibility for the project next month.
examples.zh: 她下个月将承担这个项目的责任。

examples.en: The new director assumed office in September.
examples.zh: 新主任于九月就任。

entries.definition: to tell someone confidently that something is true

examples.en: The engineer assured us that the bridge was safe.
examples.zh: 工程师向我们保证这座桥是安全的。

examples.en: I can assure you that your comments will be considered.
examples.zh: 我可以向你保证，你的意见会得到考虑。

entries.definition: to make a desired result certain

examples.en: Regular maintenance helps assure the reliability of the system.
examples.zh: 定期维护有助于保障系统的可靠性。

examples.en: The agreement assures access to clean water for the village.
examples.zh: 这份协议保障村民获得洁净水。

entries.definition: to surprise someone greatly

examples.en: The speed of the recovery astounded the doctors.
examples.zh: 恢复速度让医生们十分惊讶。

examples.en: The discovery continues to astound experienced researchers.
examples.zh: 这一发现仍让经验丰富的研究人员震惊。

entries.definition: a person trained to travel and work in space

examples.en: The astronaut practised repairs in a training pool.
examples.zh: 宇航员在训练水池中练习维修。

examples.en: Each astronaut carries out experiments during the mission.
examples.zh: 每位宇航员都在任务期间开展实验。

entries.definition: not less than a stated amount

examples.en: The walk takes at least forty minutes.
examples.zh: 步行至少需要四十分钟。

examples.en: At least three people must approve the decision.
examples.zh: 这项决定至少需要三人批准。

entries.definition: the layer of gases surrounding a planet

examples.en: The atmosphere protects Earth from some harmful radiation.
examples.zh: 大气层保护地球免受部分有害辐射。

examples.en: The probe measured gases in the planet's atmosphere.
examples.zh: 探测器测量了这颗行星大气中的气体。

entries.definition: the mood or feeling of a place or situation

examples.en: Soft lighting created a relaxed atmosphere.
examples.zh: 柔和的灯光营造了轻松的氛围。

examples.en: The meeting took place in an atmosphere of trust.
examples.zh: 会议在相互信任的气氛中进行。

entries.definition: to fasten or join something to another thing

examples.en: Attach the label to the outside of the parcel.
examples.zh: 把标签贴在包裹外面。

examples.en: Please attach a copy of your receipt to the form.
examples.zh: 请在表格后附上一份收据副本。

entries.definition: to consider something to have particular importance or value

examples.en: The school attaches great importance to independent learning.
examples.zh: 学校非常重视自主学习。

examples.en: We should not attach too much significance to one result.
examples.zh: 我们不应过分看重一个结果。

entries.definition: to assign someone or something to an organization

examples.en: Two advisers were attached to the research team.
examples.zh: 两名顾问被派到研究团队协助工作。

examples.en: The small laboratory is attached to the university.
examples.zh: 这个小实验室隶属于大学。

entries.definition: possible to achieve

examples.en: Set goals that are challenging but attainable.
examples.zh: 设定有挑战性但能够实现的目标。

examples.en: A lower energy bill is attainable with better insulation.
examples.zh: 改善隔热后，降低能源账单是可以实现的。

entries.definition: being present at a class or event

examples.en: Regular attendance is required to complete the course.
examples.zh: 完成这门课程需要定期出勤。

examples.en: The teacher keeps a record of attendance.
examples.zh: 老师记录出勤情况。

examples.en: Poor attendance may affect your final grade.
examples.zh: 出勤率低可能影响你的最终成绩。

entries.definition: The act of being present to care for someone.

examples.en: A nurse was in attendance throughout the night.
examples.zh: 一名护士整夜在场照料。

examples.en: The injured climber needed constant attendance.
examples.zh: 受伤攀岩者需要持续陪护。

entries.definition: a way of thinking or feeling about something

examples.en: Her attitude towards failure became more positive.
examples.zh: 她对失败的态度变得更加积极。

examples.en: The survey examined public attitudes to recycling.
examples.zh: 这项调查研究了公众对回收利用的看法。

entries.definition: a position of the body or an object's orientation

examples.en: The sculpture shows a figure in an attitude of prayer.
examples.zh: 这座雕塑中的人物呈祈祷姿势。

examples.en: The instruments display the aircraft's attitude during flight.
examples.zh: 仪表显示飞机飞行时的姿态。

entries.definition: pleasant or appealing to look at or consider

examples.en: The town offers attractive opportunities for young businesses.
examples.zh: 这个城镇为新创企业提供了有吸引力的机会。

examples.en: Trees made the courtyard more attractive.
examples.zh: 树木让庭院更加美观。

entries.definition: relating to sound or recorded sound

examples.en: The course includes audio exercises for every unit.
examples.zh: 这门课程为每个单元配备了音频练习。

examples.en: Please check the audio equipment before the presentation.
examples.zh: 请在演示前检查音响设备。

entries.definition: a large room or seating area for an audience

examples.en: The graduation ceremony filled the auditorium.
examples.zh: 毕业典礼使礼堂坐满了人。

examples.en: The auditorium has excellent views from every seat.
examples.zh: 观众厅的每个座位都视野良好。

entries.definition: to prove that something or someone is genuine

examples.en: Experts were asked to authenticate the painting.
examples.zh: 专家受邀鉴定这幅画的真伪。

examples.en: The device uses a fingerprint to authenticate the user.
examples.zh: 这个设备利用指纹验证用户身份。

entries.definition: a person's written account of their own life

examples.en: Her autobiography describes growing up in a coastal village.
examples.zh: 她的自传描述了在沿海村庄长大的经历。

examples.en: He began writing his autobiography after retiring.
examples.zh: 他退休后开始写自传。

entries.definition: without needing direct human control

examples.en: The lights switch off automatically after midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜后灯会自动关闭。

examples.en: The application automatically saves your work.
examples.zh: 这个应用会自动保存你的工作。

entries.definition: without consciously thinking about an action

examples.en: She automatically reached for her phone when it rang.
examples.zh: 电话响起时，她下意识地伸手去拿。

examples.en: I automatically smiled when I recognized him.
examples.zh: 认出他时，我不由自主地笑了。

entries.definition: help or benefit, especially in a negative expression

examples.en: We searched the station to no avail.
examples.zh: 我们搜遍了车站，却毫无结果。

examples.en: Her repeated warnings were of little avail.
examples.zh: 她反复的警告几乎没有起作用。

entries.definition: to be useful or helpful

examples.en: Careful planning will avail us little without action.
examples.zh: 没有行动，周密的计划也帮不了我们多少。

examples.en: His experience did not avail him in the unfamiliar situation.
examples.zh: 在这种陌生情境下，他的经验没能帮上忙。

entries.definition: to make use of an opportunity or service

examples.en: Students may avail themselves of the free advice service.
examples.zh: 学生可以利用免费的咨询服务。

examples.en: She availed herself of the chance to study abroad.
examples.zh: 她利用了这次出国学习的机会。

entries.definition: a large mass of snow sliding down a mountain

examples.en: An avalanche blocked the mountain road.
examples.zh: 一场雪崩堵住了山路。

examples.en: The team studied the path of a recent avalanche.
examples.zh: 团队研究了最近一次雪崩的路径。

entries.definition: to move downward like a mass of falling snow

examples.en: Loose snow avalanched down the steep slope.
examples.zh: 松散的积雪从陡坡上崩落。

examples.en: Rocks and ice avalanched into the valley.
examples.zh: 岩石和冰块大量坠入山谷。

entries.definition: a number representing a typical value in a set

examples.en: The average of the three scores is seventy.
examples.zh: 这三个分数的平均数是七十。

examples.en: This month's rainfall was above average.
examples.zh: 这个月的降雨量高于平均水平。

entries.definition: calculated by dividing a total by the number of items

examples.en: The average journey time is twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 平均行程时间是二十分钟。

examples.en: Average temperatures rose during the decade.
examples.zh: 这十年间平均气温上升了。

entries.definition: typical or neither very good nor very bad

examples.en: The flat is too expensive for an average household.
examples.zh: 这个公寓对普通家庭来说太贵了。

examples.en: His first exam results were fairly average.
examples.zh: 他第一次考试的成绩相当一般。

entries.definition: to have or calculate a particular mean value

examples.en: The cyclists averaged thirty kilometres an hour.
examples.zh: 骑行者的平均时速为三十公里。

examples.en: We averaged the readings from all five sensors.
examples.zh: 我们计算了五个传感器读数的平均值。

entries.definition: a prize or an amount granted by an official decision

examples.en: The film received an award for its photography.
examples.zh: 这部电影获得了摄影奖。

examples.en: The court approved an award of compensation.
examples.zh: 法院批准了赔偿裁定。

entries.definition: to officially give a prize or payment

examples.en: The university awarded her a scholarship.
examples.zh: 大学授予她一笔奖学金。

examples.en: The judge awarded damages to the injured cyclist.
examples.zh: 法官判给受伤的骑行者损害赔偿金。

entries.definition: a shaft on which a wheel turns

examples.en: The mechanic replaced the damaged rear axle.
examples.zh: 技工更换了损坏的后轴。

examples.en: A heavy load can put extra pressure on the axle.
examples.zh: 重物会给车轴增加压力。

entries.definition: the part behind the main subject or activity

examples.en: Mountains are visible in the background of the photograph.
examples.zh: 照片的背景中可以看到群山。

examples.en: Quiet music played in the background.
examples.zh: 轻柔的音乐在背景中播放。

entries.definition: a person's experience or information needed to understand something

examples.en: Her background in engineering helped with the project.
examples.zh: 她的工程学背景对这个项目很有帮助。

examples.en: The first chapter provides background to the debate.
examples.zh: 第一章提供了理解这场争论所需的背景信息。

entries.definition: computer activity running without direct user interaction

examples.en: The program checks for updates in the background.
examples.zh: 这个程序在后台检查更新。

examples.en: A background task continued after the window closed.
examples.zh: 窗口关闭后，一项后台任务仍在继续运行。

entries.definition: a game played by hitting a shuttlecock over a net

examples.en: We play badminton in the sports hall on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我们每周五在体育馆打羽毛球。

examples.en: She joined the university badminton club.
examples.zh: 她加入了大学羽毛球俱乐部。

entries.definition: a raised outdoor platform attached to a building

examples.en: We ate breakfast on the balcony overlooking the sea.
examples.zh: 我们在面朝大海的阳台上吃早餐。

examples.en: The flat has a small balcony for growing herbs.
examples.zh: 这个公寓有一个可以种香草的小阳台。

entries.definition: an upper seating area in a theatre

examples.en: Our seats were in the front row of the balcony.
examples.zh: 我们的座位在楼座第一排。

examples.en: The balcony offers a clear view of the stage.
examples.zh: 楼座可以清楚地看到舞台。

entries.definition: unable to pay debts

examples.en: The company went bankrupt after losing its main contract.
examples.zh: 这家公司失去主要合同后破产了。

examples.en: Several small shops were left bankrupt by the crisis.
examples.zh: 几家小商店因这场危机而破产。

entries.definition: a place or counter where drinks are served

examples.en: We met at a quiet bar near the station.
examples.zh: 我们在车站附近一家安静的酒吧见面。

examples.en: She ordered a juice at the bar.
examples.zh: 她在吧台点了一杯果汁。

entries.definition: a long narrow piece of solid material

examples.en: A metal bar reinforced the wooden door.
examples.zh: 一根金属条加固了木门。

examples.en: Sunlight came through the bars of the window.
examples.zh: 阳光从窗户的栅栏杆之间照了进来。

entries.definition: to prevent someone from doing or entering something

examples.en: The rules bar visitors from entering the laboratory alone.
examples.zh: 规则禁止访客独自进入实验室。

examples.en: Fallen trees barred the path through the forest.
examples.zh: 倒下的树挡住了穿过森林的小路。

entries.definition: to fasten a door with a bar

examples.en: They barred the door before the storm arrived.
examples.zh: 暴风雨来临前，他们闩住了门。

examples.en: The old gate was barred from the inside.
examples.zh: 旧大门从里面闩住了。

entries.definition: not covered by clothing or another layer

examples.en: She walked across the warm sand with bare feet.
examples.zh: 她赤脚走过温暖的沙滩。

examples.en: The wind stripped the branches bare.
examples.zh: 风把树枝吹得光秃秃的。

entries.meaning: 空的；仅有最基本内容的
entries.definition: without furniture, decoration, or extra detail

examples.en: The room was bare except for a wooden chair.
examples.zh: 房间里除了一把木椅外空无一物。

examples.en: The report gave only the bare facts.
examples.zh: 报告只提供了最基本的事实。

entries.definition: a flat-bottomed boat used to transport heavy goods

examples.en: A barge carried timber along the canal.
examples.zh: 一艘驳船沿运河运送木材。

examples.en: The workers unloaded sand from the barge.
examples.zh: 工人们从驳船上卸下沙子。

entries.definition: to move forcefully and without care

examples.en: He barged past the queue and entered the hall.
examples.zh: 他从队伍旁猛冲过去，闯进大厅。

examples.en: Please knock rather than barge into the office.
examples.zh: 请先敲门，不要直接闯进办公室。

entries.meaning: 密集炮火；大量接连不断的攻击或提问
entries.definition: a concentrated attack or a rapid series of things

examples.en: The troops advanced behind an artillery barrage.
examples.zh: 部队在密集炮火掩护下推进。

examples.en: The speaker faced a barrage of questions.
examples.zh: 演讲者遭遇了一连串问题。

entries.definition: a structure that blocks movement or separates areas

examples.en: A safety barrier kept visitors away from the cliff.
examples.zh: 安全护栏让游客远离悬崖。

examples.en: Passengers must show their tickets at the barrier.
examples.zh: 乘客必须在检票闸口出示车票。

entries.definition: something that prevents progress or communication

examples.en: High fees create a barrier to further education.
examples.zh: 高昂的费用构成了继续接受教育的障碍。

examples.en: Shared activities helped break down the language barrier.
examples.zh: 共同活动有助于消除语言隔阂。

entries.definition: a device that stores and supplies electrical energy

examples.en: The camera battery needs charging.
examples.zh: 相机电池需要充电。

examples.en: The bus uses a large battery instead of diesel.
examples.zh: 这辆公共汽车使用大型蓄电池而非柴油。

entries.definition: a narrow stream of light or radiation

examples.en: A beam of sunlight entered through the roof.
examples.zh: 一束阳光从屋顶照了进来。

examples.en: The scanner directs a beam towards the surface.
examples.zh: 扫描仪把一束射线对准表面。

entries.definition: a long support in a building

examples.en: A wooden beam supports the ceiling.
examples.zh: 一根木梁支撑着天花板。

examples.en: The engineer inspected the damaged steel beam.
examples.zh: 工程师检查了损坏的钢梁。

entries.definition: a broad and happy smile

examples.en: A beam of delight lit up her face.
examples.zh: 她的脸上绽放出喜悦的笑容。

examples.en: He greeted the children with a cheerful beam.
examples.zh: 他满面笑容地迎接孩子们。

entries.definition: to smile broadly with happiness

examples.en: She beamed when her name was announced.
examples.zh: 听到自己的名字被宣布时，她笑容满面。

examples.en: The proud parents beamed at their daughter.
examples.zh: 自豪的父母对着女儿灿烂地微笑。

entries.definition: to send a signal or light in a particular direction

examples.en: The satellite beams weather data to the station.
examples.zh: 卫星向地面站传送天气数据。

examples.en: They beamed the concert to audiences around the world.
examples.zh: 他们向世界各地的观众播送了这场音乐会。

entries.definition: covered with dirt or soot

examples.en: His begrimed coat showed a long day in the workshop.
examples.zh: 他满是污垢的外套表明他在车间忙了一整天。

examples.en: They cleaned the begrimed windows of the abandoned shop.
examples.zh: 他们擦洗了废弃商店满是污垢的窗户。

entries.definition: to act in a particular way or act politely

examples.en: The children behaved well during the visit.
examples.zh: 孩子们参观时表现很好。

examples.en: People may behave differently when they know they are watched.
examples.zh: 人们知道有人观察时，行为可能有所不同。

entries.definition: to operate or respond in a particular way

examples.en: The engine behaves strangely in very cold weather.
examples.zh: 发动机在严寒天气下运行异常。

examples.en: Scientists studied how the material behaves under pressure.
examples.zh: 科学家研究了这种材料在压力下的表现。

entries.definition: in a lower position than something

examples.en: A narrow stream runs beneath the bridge.
examples.zh: 一条窄溪从桥下流过。

examples.en: She found the missing key beneath a pile of papers.
examples.zh: 她在一堆文件下面找到了丢失的钥匙。

entries.definition: in a lower place

examples.en: The upper layer was dry, but the soil beneath was wet.
examples.zh: 表层很干，但下面的土壤是湿的。

examples.en: A glass floor revealed the ancient foundations beneath.
examples.zh: 玻璃地板显露出下方古老的地基。

entries.definition: kind and willing to help others

examples.en: A benevolent donor paid for the library repairs.
examples.zh: 一位慷慨的捐赠者出资修缮图书馆。

examples.en: The story describes a benevolent ruler who protects the poor.
examples.zh: 故事描述了一位保护穷人的仁慈统治者。

entries.definition: in addition to something

examples.en: Besides English, she speaks two other languages.
examples.zh: 除了英语，她还会说另外两种语言。

examples.en: Who besides the manager can approve this request?
examples.zh: 除了经理，还有谁能批准这项请求？

entries.definition: used to add another reason or fact

examples.en: The route is shorter; besides, it avoids the busy road.
examples.zh: 这条路线更短，而且避开了繁忙的道路。

examples.en: I do not need another bag, and besides, it is expensive.
examples.zh: 我不需要另一个包，而且它很贵。

entries.definition: a drink other than plain water in formal usage

examples.en: Hot beverages are available near the entrance.
examples.zh: 入口附近供应热饮。

examples.en: The café offers several sugar-free beverages.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆提供多种无糖饮料。

entries.definition: on the far side of something

examples.en: There is a small village beyond the hills.
examples.zh: 山的那边有一个小村庄。

examples.en: The footpath continues beyond the old bridge.
examples.zh: 这条步道越过旧桥继续向前延伸。

entries.definition: outside the limits of something

examples.en: The repairs are beyond our current budget.
examples.zh: 修理费用超出了我们目前的预算。

examples.en: The full effects are beyond what the study can measure.
examples.zh: 全部影响超出了这项研究能够测量的范围。

entries.definition: apart from or in addition to something

examples.en: She knew little about the city beyond its name.
examples.zh: 除了名字，她对这座城市几乎一无所知。

examples.en: The offer includes nothing beyond basic accommodation.
examples.zh: 除基本住宿外，这项优惠不包括其他服务。

entries.definition: a list of books and other sources on a subject

examples.en: Include a bibliography at the end of your essay.
examples.zh: 请在文章末尾附上参考书目。

examples.en: The librarian compiled a bibliography of local history.
examples.zh: 图书管理员编制了一份地方史书目。

entries.definition: the study and description of books as publications

examples.en: Her research combines bibliography with literary history.
examples.zh: 她的研究结合了文献学与文学史。

examples.en: The course introduces methods used in analytical bibliography.
examples.zh: 这门课程介绍分析书目学使用的方法。

entries.meaning: 双语的；会说两种语言的
entries.definition: using or able to use two languages

examples.en: The museum provides bilingual signs throughout the building.
examples.zh: 博物馆各处都设有双语标识。

examples.en: Growing up in two countries made him bilingual.
examples.zh: 在两个国家成长使他能说两种语言。

entries.definition: a device with two lenses for viewing distant objects

examples.en: We used binoculars to watch birds across the lake.
examples.zh: 我们用双筒望远镜观察湖对面的鸟。

examples.en: She packed a pair of binoculars for the hiking trip.
examples.zh: 她为徒步旅行装了一副双筒望远镜。

entries.definition: relating to living things or their study

examples.en: The river supports a rich biological community.
examples.zh: 这条河养育着丰富的生物群落。

examples.en: The samples were sent for biological analysis.
examples.zh: 样本被送去进行生物学分析。

entries.definition: a small amount or piece

examples.en: Could you move the chair a bit closer?
examples.zh: 你能把椅子挪近一点吗？

examples.en: A small bit of glass remained on the floor.
examples.zh: 地板上还留着一小片玻璃。

entries.definition: to hold someone responsible for something bad

examples.en: Do not blame the driver before checking the evidence.
examples.zh: 查看证据前不要责怪司机。

examples.en: They blamed the delay on a signal failure.
examples.zh: 他们把延误归咎于信号故障。

entries.definition: to break or destroy something with an explosion

examples.en: Engineers blasted a tunnel through the rock.
examples.zh: 工程师在岩石中炸出了一条隧道。

examples.en: The old chimney was blasted into small pieces.
examples.zh: 旧烟囱被炸成了碎块。

entries.definition: an explosion or its sudden force

examples.en: The blast shattered windows in nearby buildings.
examples.zh: 爆炸震碎了附近建筑的窗户。

examples.en: Workers heard a distant blast from the quarry.
examples.zh: 工人听见远处采石场传来爆炸声。

entries.definition: a sudden strong movement of air

examples.en: A blast of cold air entered when the door opened.
examples.zh: 门一开，一阵冷风吹了进来。

examples.en: The heater sent a blast of warm air across the room.
examples.zh: 暖气机向房间里吹出一股热风。

entries.definition: to mix together smoothly

examples.en: Blend the fruit with milk until smooth.
examples.zh: 把水果和牛奶搅拌至均匀顺滑。

examples.en: The extension blends well with the older building.
examples.zh: 扩建部分与旧建筑融合得很好。

entries.definition: a mixture of different things

examples.en: The fabric is a blend of wool and cotton.
examples.zh: 这种织物是羊毛与棉的混纺。

examples.en: The festival offers a blend of music and storytelling.
examples.zh: 这个节日将音乐与讲故事结合在一起。

entries.definition: a flower or the condition of flowering

examples.en: The rose produced its first bloom in May.
examples.zh: 这株玫瑰五月开出了第一朵花。

examples.en: The orchard is in bloom every spring.
examples.zh: 果园每年春天都花开满园。

entries.definition: a healthy and fresh appearance

examples.en: The fresh air brought a bloom to her cheeks.
examples.zh: 新鲜空气使她双颊泛起健康的红晕。

examples.en: The portrait captures the bloom of youth.
examples.zh: 这幅肖像捕捉到了青春焕发的神采。

entries.definition: to produce flowers or develop successfully

examples.en: The cherry trees bloom early in a warm spring.
examples.zh: 春天天暖时，樱桃树会提早开花。

examples.en: Her confidence bloomed after the successful presentation.
examples.zh: 演示成功后，她的信心大增。

entries.definition: a flat piece of solid material

examples.en: They placed a board across the muddy path.
examples.zh: 他们在泥泞的小路上铺了一块木板。

examples.en: Write your name on the board near the entrance.
examples.zh: 请把名字写在入口附近的板上。

entries.definition: a group responsible for managing an organization

examples.en: The board approved the new budget.
examples.zh: 董事会批准了新预算。

examples.en: She joined the hospital board last year.
examples.zh: 她去年加入了医院管理委员会。

entries.definition: to support something and make it stronger

examples.en: The grant will bolster research in renewable energy.
examples.zh: 这笔资助将加强可再生能源研究。

examples.en: Positive feedback helped bolster her confidence.
examples.zh: 积极反馈帮助她增强了信心。

entries.definition: a long firm pillow used for support

examples.en: She placed a bolster behind her back.
examples.zh: 她在背后放了一个长垫枕。

examples.en: The sofa came with two cylindrical bolsters.
examples.zh: 这张沙发配有两个圆柱形长枕。

entries.definition: a support that holds a book open for reading

examples.en: The bookrest keeps the recipe visible while I cook.
examples.zh: 我做饭时，书本支架让食谱保持清楚可见。

examples.en: She adjusted the bookrest to a comfortable angle.
examples.zh: 她把阅书架调到了舒适的角度。

entries.definition: a shoe that covers the foot and part of the leg

examples.en: Wear a waterproof boot on each foot in the marsh.
examples.zh: 在沼泽地里要穿上防水靴。

examples.en: He cleaned the mud from his walking boots.
examples.zh: 他清除了徒步靴上的泥。

entries.definition: the enclosed storage space at the back of a car

examples.en: Put the suitcase in the boot.
examples.zh: 把行李箱放进汽车后备箱。

examples.en: The boot has enough space for two folding chairs.
examples.zh: 后备箱有足够空间放两把折叠椅。

entries.definition: dismissal from a job or position

examples.en: He got the boot after repeatedly missing work.
examples.zh: 他多次旷工后被解雇了。

examples.en: The manager gave the unreliable contractor the boot.
examples.zh: 经理解雇了那个不可靠的承包商。

entries.definition: to make someone feel uninterested

examples.en: The repetitive lecture bored the students.
examples.zh: 重复乏味的讲课让学生们感到厌烦。

examples.en: I will not bore you with every detail.
examples.zh: 我不会用每个细节来烦你。

entries.definition: to make a hole by drilling

examples.en: Workers bored a hole through the concrete wall.
examples.zh: 工人在混凝土墙上钻了一个孔。

examples.en: The machine can bore through hard rock.
examples.zh: 这台机器能够钻穿坚硬的岩石。

entries.definition: a person or activity that is dull and tedious

examples.en: Sorting those old receipts was a terrible bore.
examples.zh: 整理那些旧收据真是件无聊的事。

examples.en: He becomes a bore when he repeats the same story.
examples.zh: 他一遍遍讲同一个故事时就让人厌烦。

entries.definition: to spring back after hitting a surface or move up and down

examples.en: The ball bounced off the wall.
examples.zh: 球撞到墙后弹了回来。

examples.en: The bus bounced along the uneven road.
examples.zh: 公共汽车在崎岖的道路上颠簸前行。

entries.definition: an upward movement after hitting a surface

examples.en: The ball took an unexpected bounce.
examples.zh: 球出人意料地弹了一下。

examples.en: This old mattress has lost its bounce.
examples.zh: 这张旧床垫失去了弹性。

entries.definition: energy and enthusiasm

examples.en: The holiday put the bounce back in her step.
examples.zh: 假期让她的步伐重新充满活力。

examples.en: The young presenter brought bounce to the programme.
examples.zh: 这位年轻主持人为节目带来了活力。

entries.definition: a line separating areas or limits

examples.en: A stone wall marks the boundary between the farms.
examples.zh: 一道石墙标明两座农场的分界线。

examples.en: The discussion crossed the boundary between science and ethics.
examples.zh: 这场讨论跨越了科学与伦理的界限。

entries.definition: a name identifying a company's product

examples.en: This brand is known for reliable outdoor clothing.
examples.zh: 这个品牌以可靠的户外服装著称。

examples.en: The shop sells several local brands of cheese.
examples.zh: 这家店出售几个本地品牌的奶酪。

entries.definition: to mark something permanently with a hot tool or symbol

examples.en: The farmer branded the cattle for identification.
examples.zh: 农场主给牛打上烙印以便识别。

examples.en: The maker's initials were branded into the wooden handle.
examples.zh: 制作者姓名的首字母被烙在木柄上。

entries.definition: to publicly describe someone in a strongly negative way

examples.en: Critics branded the proposal unrealistic.
examples.zh: 批评者将这项提议斥为不切实际。

examples.en: She was unfairly branded a troublemaker.
examples.zh: 她被不公正地扣上了惹事者的帽子。

entries.definition: a failure of a machine, system, or relationship

examples.en: A mechanical breakdown delayed the train.
examples.zh: 机械故障使火车晚点。

examples.en: The talks ended in a breakdown of trust.
examples.zh: 会谈最终导致信任破裂。

entries.definition: a serious collapse in someone's health or ability to function

examples.en: Months of pressure led to a nervous breakdown.
examples.zh: 数月的压力导致精神崩溃。

examples.en: She took time off after a breakdown in her health.
examples.zh: 健康严重恶化后，她休了一段时间假。

entries.definition: a division of a total into separate parts

examples.en: Please provide a breakdown of the travel costs.
examples.zh: 请提供旅行费用的分类明细。

examples.en: The chart gives a breakdown of students by age.
examples.zh: 这张图表按年龄细分了学生人数。

entries.definition: to produce young animals or raise particular varieties

examples.en: These birds breed on remote islands.
examples.zh: 这些鸟在偏远岛屿上繁殖。

examples.en: The farm breeds sheep for their fine wool.
examples.zh: 这个农场培育绵羊以获取细羊毛。

entries.definition: to cause a feeling or problem to develop

examples.en: Long delays can breed resentment.
examples.zh: 长时间延误可能滋生怨恨。

examples.en: A lack of clear information breeds confusion.
examples.zh: 缺乏清楚的信息会造成混乱。

entries.definition: a particular variety of an animal or group

examples.en: This breed of dog needs plenty of exercise.
examples.zh: 这个品种的狗需要大量运动。

examples.en: The exhibition features several rare cattle breeds.
examples.zh: 展览展示了几个稀有的牛品种。

entries.definition: lasting for a short time or using few words

examples.en: We took a brief break before the next session.
examples.zh: 我们在下一场开始前短暂休息。

examples.en: The guide gave a brief explanation of the building.
examples.zh: 导游简要介绍了这栋建筑。

entries.definition: a concise description of a task or case

examples.en: The designer received a detailed project brief.
examples.zh: 设计师收到了一份详细的项目任务说明。

examples.en: The legal team prepared a brief for the hearing.
examples.zh: 法律团队为听证准备了一份案情摘要。

entries.meaning: 介绍情况；提供必要资讯
entries.definition: to give someone essential information

examples.en: The leader briefed the volunteers before they left.
examples.zh: 负责人在志愿者出发前向他们介绍了情况。

examples.en: Please brief the new colleague on the safety procedure.
examples.zh: 请向新同事介绍安全流程。

entries.definition: shining with strong light or colour

examples.en: Brilliant sunlight flooded the courtyard.
examples.zh: 灿烂的阳光洒满庭院。

examples.en: The bird had brilliant blue feathers.
examples.zh: 这只鸟有鲜亮的蓝色羽毛。

entries.definition: extremely clever or impressive

examples.en: She proposed a brilliant solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 她提出了一个解决问题的绝妙办法。

examples.en: The brilliant young pianist won a scholarship.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的年轻钢琴家获得了奖学金。

entries.definition: hard but easily broken or damaged

examples.en: The old paper was yellow and brittle.
examples.zh: 旧纸张已经发黄发脆。

examples.en: Cold weather made the plastic brittle.
examples.zh: 寒冷天气使塑料变脆了。

entries.meaning: 情绪脆弱的；生硬紧张的
entries.definition: appearing controlled but nervous or easily upset

examples.en: Her brittle confidence disappeared after the criticism.
examples.zh: 受到批评后，她脆弱的自信消失了。

examples.en: His brittle smile did little to hide his anxiety.
examples.zh: 他生硬的微笑几乎掩盖不了焦虑。

entries.definition: sharp and tense in sound

examples.en: A brittle laugh broke the uncomfortable silence.
examples.zh: 一声尖利而紧张的笑打破了尴尬的沉默。

examples.en: Her voice became brittle as the interview continued.
examples.zh: 随着访谈继续，她的声音变得尖利紧张。

entries.definition: to dwell unhappily on something

examples.en: He brooded over the mistake all evening.
examples.zh: 他整个晚上都为那个错误耿耿于怀。

examples.en: Try not to brood on comments that cannot be changed.
examples.zh: 尽量不要一直为那些无法改变的评论烦恼。

entries.definition: to keep eggs or young birds warm

examples.en: The hen brooded quietly in the nesting box.
examples.zh: 母鸡在巢箱里安静地孵蛋。

examples.en: The parent birds take turns brooding the chicks.
examples.zh: 亲鸟轮流给雏鸟保温。

entries.definition: young animals born or hatched together

examples.en: A brood of ducklings followed the mother across the pond.
examples.zh: 一窝小鸭跟着母鸭游过池塘。

examples.en: The researchers counted the chicks in each brood.
examples.zh: 研究人员清点了每窝雏鸟的数量。

entries.meaning: 最主要的冲击；最沉重的负担
entries.definition: the greatest force or worst part of something

examples.en: Coastal villages bore the brunt of the storm.
examples.zh: 沿海村庄承受了风暴最猛烈的冲击。

examples.en: Small businesses took the brunt of the sudden price rise.
examples.zh: 小企业承受了价格骤涨的主要冲击。

entries.definition: an open container with a handle

examples.en: She filled a bucket with water from the tap.
examples.zh: 她从水龙头接满了一桶水。

examples.en: We used two buckets to collect rainwater.
examples.zh: 我们用两个桶收集雨水。

entries.definition: a plan for how much money to spend

examples.en: We need to stay within our monthly budget.
examples.zh: 我们需要将开支控制在月度预算内。

examples.en: The council increased the budget for libraries.
examples.zh: 地方议会增加了图书馆预算。

examples.en: Prepare a detailed budget before starting the project.
examples.zh: 项目开始前请准备详细预算。

entries.definition: To plan how money or time will be used.

examples.en: We budgeted carefully for the renovation.
examples.zh: 我们为翻修仔细编制了预算。

examples.en: She budgets a fixed amount each month for travel.
examples.zh: 她每月为旅行安排固定金额。

entries.definition: to swell outward or be very full

examples.en: The bag bulged with library books.
examples.zh: 包里装满了图书馆的书，鼓鼓囊囊的。

examples.en: The damaged wall began to bulge outward.
examples.zh: 受损的墙开始向外鼓起。

entries.definition: a rounded swelling or temporary increase

examples.en: The doctor examined the small bulge under the skin.
examples.zh: 医生检查了皮肤下面的小肿块。

examples.en: The school prepared for a bulge in enrolment.
examples.zh: 学校为入学人数激增作好了准备。

entries.definition: a short official report or announcement

examples.en: The radio bulletin reported a road closure.
examples.zh: 广播新闻简报报道了一条道路封闭的消息。

examples.en: A safety bulletin was sent to every department.
examples.zh: 一份安全公告被发送到每个部门。

entries.definition: a periodical issued by an organization

examples.en: Her article appeared in the society's quarterly bulletin.
examples.zh: 她的文章发表在该学会的季度会刊上。

examples.en: The museum bulletin describes recent discoveries.
examples.zh: 博物馆刊物介绍了近期的发现。

entries.definition: to meet someone unexpectedly

examples.en: I bumped into an old teacher at the market.
examples.zh: 我在市场偶遇了以前的一位老师。

examples.en: You may bump into colleagues at the conference.
examples.zh: 你可能会在会议上偶遇同事。

entries.definition: an office or organization providing a service

examples.en: The tourism bureau supplied a map of the city.
examples.zh: 旅游局提供了一张城市地图。

examples.en: She contacted the local advice bureau.
examples.zh: 她联系了当地咨询机构。

entries.definition: a person who enters a building to steal

examples.en: A burglar entered through the unlocked window.
examples.zh: 一名窃贼从未锁的窗户进入。

examples.en: The police found the burglar carrying stolen jewellery.
examples.zh: 警方发现窃贼携带着偷来的珠宝。

entries.definition: to put someone or something under the ground

examples.en: They buried the seeds in moist soil.
examples.zh: 他们把种子埋进湿润的土壤。

examples.en: The family chose to bury him in his home village.
examples.zh: 家人决定把他安葬在家乡的村庄。

entries.definition: to hide something deeply or become absorbed in it

examples.en: The key was buried beneath a pile of letters.
examples.zh: 钥匙藏在一堆信件下面。

examples.en: She buried herself in work after the move.
examples.zh: 搬家后，她埋头工作。

entries.definition: a restaurant where people collect food at a counter

examples.en: We had lunch in the school cafeteria.
examples.zh: 我们在学校食堂吃了午饭。

examples.en: The cafeteria offers a vegetarian meal every day.
examples.zh: 食堂每天提供素食餐。

entries.definition: a chart showing days, weeks, and months

examples.en: Mark the deadline on your calendar.
examples.zh: 在日历上标出截止日期。

examples.en: The wall calendar features photographs of local wildlife.
examples.zh: 墙上的月历印有当地野生动物的照片。

entries.definition: a schedule of planned events

examples.en: The conference calendar is available online.
examples.zh: 会议日程可以在线查看。

examples.en: She added the meeting to her shared calendar.
examples.zh: 她把会议加入了共享日程表。

entries.definition: the quality or ability of a person or thing

examples.en: The scholarship attracts researchers of a high calibre.
examples.zh: 这项奖学金吸引了高水平的研究人员。

examples.en: We need candidates of the right calibre for this role.
examples.zh: 这个职位需要能力合适的候选人。

entries.definition: the internal diameter of a gun barrel

examples.en: The museum label identifies the weapon's calibre.
examples.zh: 博物馆标签标明了这件武器的口径。

examples.en: The two historic cannon differ in calibre.
examples.zh: 这两门古炮口径不同。

entries.definition: a large desert animal with one or two humps

examples.en: The camel carried supplies across the dry plain.
examples.zh: 骆驼载着物资穿过干旱的平原。

examples.en: A camel can close its nostrils against blowing sand.
examples.zh: 骆驼能闭合鼻孔以阻挡风沙。

entries.definition: an organized effort to achieve a goal

examples.en: The campaign encourages people to use less plastic.
examples.zh: 这项活动鼓励人们减少塑料使用。

examples.en: The election campaign lasted six weeks.
examples.zh: 竞选活动持续了六周。

entries.definition: a series of connected military operations

examples.en: The historian studied the campaign in the northern region.
examples.zh: 这位历史学家研究了北部地区的战役。

examples.en: The campaign ended when the opposing armies withdrew.
examples.zh: 对立军队撤退后，这场战役结束了。

entries.definition: to work actively towards a public goal

examples.en: Students campaigned for safer cycle routes.
examples.zh: 学生们发起活动争取更安全的自行车道。

examples.en: The group has campaigned against river pollution for years.
examples.zh: 这个团体多年来一直开展反对河流污染的活动。

entries.definition: to take part in a series of military operations

examples.en: The army campaigned through the winter.
examples.zh: 这支军队整个冬天都在作战。

examples.en: The general had campaigned in several distant regions.
examples.zh: 这位将军曾在几个遥远地区参加战役。

entries.definition: the grounds and buildings of a university or college

examples.en: The library stands at the centre of the campus.
examples.zh: 图书馆位于校园中央。

examples.en: Bicycles are a popular way to travel around campus.
examples.zh: 自行车是校园内常见的出行方式。

entries.definition: a large heavy gun

examples.en: An old cannon stood beside the castle gate.
examples.zh: 城堡门旁立着一门古炮。

examples.en: The museum restored the bronze cannon.
examples.zh: 博物馆修复了这门青铜炮。

entries.definition: the Cantonese language or a person from Guangdong

examples.en: She speaks Cantonese with her grandparents.
examples.zh: 她和祖父母说粤语。

examples.en: Many Cantonese settled in the city during that period.
examples.zh: 那个时期许多广东人在这座城市定居。

entries.definition: relating to Guangdong or its language and culture

examples.en: The programme includes Cantonese dialogue.
examples.zh: 这个节目包含粤语对话。

examples.en: We tried traditional Cantonese dishes at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 我们在餐馆品尝了传统粤菜。

entries.definition: the maximum amount something can hold

examples.en: The hall has a capacity of three hundred people.
examples.zh: 大厅可容纳三百人。

examples.en: The reservoir is operating at half its capacity.
examples.zh: 水库目前蓄水量为容量的一半。

entries.definition: the power or ability to do something

examples.en: The brain has a remarkable capacity to learn.
examples.zh: 大脑具有惊人的学习能力。

examples.en: The factory increased its production capacity.
examples.zh: 工厂提高了生产能力。

entries.definition: kept confined and unable to leave

examples.en: Researchers observed the behaviour of captive birds.
examples.zh: 研究人员观察了圈养鸟类的行为。

examples.en: The captive soldiers waited for news of their release.
examples.zh: 被俘士兵等待获释的消息。

entries.meaning: 受控制的；无法自由选择的
entries.definition: unable to choose an alternative or avoid something

examples.en: Commuters on the only bus form a captive market.
examples.zh: 只能乘坐这条公交线路的通勤者构成了被垄断的市场。

examples.en: The long journey gave the speaker a captive audience.
examples.zh: 漫长旅程让演讲者有了一群无法离开的听众。

entries.meaning: 俘虏；被囚禁的人或动物
entries.definition: a person or animal kept confined

examples.en: The captives were released after negotiations.
examples.zh: 谈判后，俘虏被释放了。

examples.en: The injured captive was moved to a larger enclosure.
examples.zh: 那只受伤的圈养动物被移到更大的围栏中。

entries.definition: relating to the heart and blood vessels

examples.en: The study examined cardiovascular health in older adults.
examples.zh: 这项研究考察了老年人的心血管健康。

examples.en: The hospital has a specialist cardiovascular research unit.
examples.zh: 这家医院设有专门的心血管研究部门。

entries.definition: to take something from one place to another

examples.en: Could you carry this box upstairs?
examples.zh: 你能把这个箱子搬上楼吗？

examples.en: The ferry carries passengers to the island.
examples.zh: 渡船把乘客运到岛上。

entries.definition: to transmit a signal, sound, or substance

examples.en: Water can carry pollutants into the river.
examples.zh: 水会把污染物带入河流。

examples.en: The wind carried their voices across the field.
examples.zh: 风把他们的声音传过田野。

entries.definition: the act or distance of transporting something by hand

examples.en: There was a long carry from the car park to the campsite.
examples.zh: 从停车场到营地需要搬运很长一段路。

examples.en: The final carry took the equipment over a rocky path.
examples.zh: 最后一段搬运需要把设备运过岩石小路。

entries.definition: the distance travelled by a ball or projectile before landing

examples.en: The golfer needed a carry of two hundred metres.
examples.zh: 这位高尔夫球手需要打出两百米的空中距离。

examples.en: The wind reduced the carry of the shot.
examples.zh: 风缩短了这一击的飞行距离。

entries.definition: money in the form of notes and coins

examples.en: The market stall accepts only cash.
examples.zh: 这个市场摊位只收现金。

examples.en: I keep a little cash for emergencies.
examples.zh: 我留了一点现金应急。

entries.definition: to exchange a cheque or similar document for money

examples.en: She went to the bank to cash the cheque.
examples.zh: 她到银行兑现支票。

examples.en: You can cash the voucher at the reception desk.
examples.zh: 你可以在前台兑现这张凭券。

entries.definition: relaxed or done without much thought

examples.en: A casual remark led to a useful discussion.
examples.zh: 一句随口的评论引出了一场有益的讨论。

examples.en: He gave the timetable a casual glance.
examples.zh: 他随意瞥了一眼时刻表。

entries.definition: informal or not arranged on a permanent basis

examples.en: The office allows casual clothing on Fridays.
examples.zh: 办公室允许员工周五穿便装。

examples.en: She found casual work during the summer.
examples.zh: 她在夏天找到了临时工作。

entries.definition: an event causing great damage or suffering

examples.en: The flood was a catastrophe for local farms.
examples.zh: 这场洪水对当地农场而言是一场灾难。

examples.en: Early warnings helped prevent a major catastrophe.
examples.zh: 提前预警有助于避免一场重大灾难。

entries.definition: to supply food and drink for an event

examples.en: The restaurant will cater for the conference.
examples.zh: 这家餐馆将为会议提供餐饮。

examples.en: Her business caters weddings and private parties.
examples.zh: 她的公司承办婚礼和私人聚会的餐饮。

entries.definition: to provide what a group needs or wants

examples.en: The course caters for learners with different backgrounds.
examples.zh: 这门课程满足不同背景学习者的需要。

examples.en: The website caters to people planning independent travel.
examples.zh: 这个网站面向计划自由行的人提供服务。

entries.definition: careful to avoid danger or mistakes

examples.en: Investors remained cautious after the sudden price fall.
examples.zh: 价格突然下跌后，投资者仍保持谨慎。

examples.en: Take a cautious approach when interpreting a small sample.
examples.zh: 解释小样本时要采取谨慎态度。

entries.definition: to mark a happy event with special activities

examples.en: We held a picnic to celebrate the end of term.
examples.zh: 我们举行野餐庆祝学期结束。

examples.en: The town celebrated the opening of its new library.
examples.zh: 全镇庆祝新图书馆开馆。

entries.definition: to publicly honour something admirable

examples.en: The exhibition celebrates the achievements of local artists.
examples.zh: 这场展览颂扬当地艺术家的成就。

examples.en: Her poems celebrate the beauty of ordinary places.
examples.zh: 她的诗歌赞美平凡地方的美。

entries.definition: the smallest basic unit of living organisms

examples.en: The microscope revealed changes inside the cell.
examples.zh: 显微镜显示了细胞内部的变化。

examples.en: Each cell contains structures that perform different tasks.
examples.zh: 每个细胞都含有承担不同任务的结构。

entries.definition: a small room, especially in a prison

examples.en: The prisoner returned to his cell.
examples.zh: 囚犯回到了牢房。

examples.en: The old monastery has a tiny cell for each monk.
examples.zh: 这座旧修道院为每位修士设有一间小房间。

entries.definition: a unit that produces electrical energy

examples.en: The battery contains six separate cells.
examples.zh: 这组电池含有六个独立电池单元。

examples.en: A solar cell converts light into electricity.
examples.zh: 太阳能电池把光转化为电。

entries.definition: the hundredth anniversary of an event

examples.en: The school celebrated its centennial with an exhibition.
examples.zh: 学校通过展览庆祝百年校庆。

examples.en: A new garden was planted for the town's centennial.
examples.zh: 为纪念建镇一百周年，人们建了一座新花园。

entries.definition: relating to a hundredth anniversary

examples.en: The centennial ceremony brought former students together.
examples.zh: 百年校庆仪式让昔日学生欢聚一堂。

examples.en: The museum issued a centennial collection of photographs.
examples.zh: 博物馆出版了一本百年纪念摄影集。

entries.definition: made from clay hardened by heat

examples.en: The floor is covered with ceramic tiles.
examples.zh: 地面铺着陶瓷砖。

examples.en: Ceramic cups retain heat well.
examples.zh: 陶瓷杯保温效果不错。

entries.definition: an object or material made by firing clay

examples.en: The gallery displays ceramics by local makers.
examples.zh: 这家画廊展出当地工匠的陶瓷作品。

examples.en: This technical ceramic can withstand high temperatures.
examples.zh: 这种工业陶瓷能够耐受高温。

entries.definition: an official document confirming a fact or qualification

examples.en: She received a certificate after completing the course.
examples.zh: 完成课程后，她获得了证书。

examples.en: Bring your birth certificate when you register.
examples.zh: 登记时请带上出生证明。

entries.definition: connected metal links used for fastening or restraint

examples.en: A heavy chain secured the gate.
examples.zh: 一条粗链锁住了大门。

examples.en: The prisoner was freed from his chains.
examples.zh: 囚犯被解除了镣铐。

entries.definition: a connected series of events or businesses

examples.en: One error triggered a chain of delays.
examples.zh: 一个错误引发了一连串延误。

examples.en: The bakery belongs to a regional chain.
examples.zh: 这家面包店属于一个地区连锁品牌。

entries.definition: to fasten something with a chain

examples.en: He chained his bicycle to the railing.
examples.zh: 他用链条把自行车锁在栏杆上。

examples.en: The boats were chained together during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨期间，船只被用链条连在一起。

entries.definition: the winner of a competition

examples.en: The local champion qualified for the national race.
examples.zh: 本地冠军取得了全国比赛的资格。

examples.en: She became world champion at the age of twenty.
examples.zh: 她二十岁时成为世界冠军。

entries.definition: a state of complete disorder

examples.en: The power failure caused chaos at the station.
examples.zh: 停电使车站陷入混乱。

examples.en: Clear signs restored order after the initial chaos.
examples.zh: 清楚的指示牌让最初的混乱恢复了秩序。

entries.definition: a distinguishing feature
